title: [GMCP 203.011.05] Interoperability and quality: Complete prompt and completion server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-011-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Prompt discovery/get and argument completion implement all current schemas, roles, embedded content, pagination/filtering, list changes, cache semantics, validation, cancellation, authorization, and deterministic ranking. Prompt templates are immutable per advertised version, untrusted substitutions remain data, and injection, oversized expansion, missing argument, localization, and concurrent-update cases are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: The shipped prompt catalog provides the single built-in `use_tool` prompt without an interactive multi-turn `input_required` elicitation flow (`GetPromptResult.resultType = complete`); dynamic `GmcpService::register_prompt` / `notifications/prompts/list_changed` emissions run in-process only.

On Windows hosts, adapter transport parity exercises stdio (`2025-11-25` and `2026-07-28`), Streamable HTTP loopback, and in-process `embedded_adapter`; Unix-domain socket adapter parity is gated `#[cfg(unix)]`.

reuse.reason: Production prompt and completion handlers (`list_prompts`, `get_prompt`, `complete`), snapshot-revision cursor pagination (`page`), `Change::Prompts` list_changed notifications, and `2026-07-28` HTTP `Mcp-Method`/`Mcp-Name` enforcement already exist in `crates/susi-gmcp`; `GMCP-203-011-05` verifies cross-era, cross-transport, direct-vs-gateway parity, property invariants, and budgets against that production code.
reuse.searched: Susi Core: crates/susi-gmcp/src/protocol.rs (`GmcpService`, `list_prompts`, `get_prompt`, `complete`, `register_prompt`, `page`), crates/susi-gmcp/src/catalog.rs (`use_tool`, `susi://tools/{name}`), crates/susi-gmcp/src/mcp/http.rs (`HEADER_MCP_NAME`, `validate_request_headers`), crates/susi-gmcp/src/mcp/model.rs (`Prompt`, `PromptMessage`, `GetPromptResult`), docs/gmcp/contract-203-011.md, and tests/gmcp_requirements.rs.
